focus.title: 欧盟对华电动车反补贴税终裁落地，出海企业须重估供应链与定价
focus.summary: 欧盟委员会近日公布对华电动汽车反补贴调查终裁措施，在原有10%基础关税上叠加差异化税率，并设定价格承诺谈判窗口。对中国车企而言，短期应评估出口成本转嫁空间与本地化组装可行性，同步核查电池原产地与补贴披露口径；对零部件与储能企业，需警惕调查范围外溢。建议企业建立关税情景模型，预留价格承诺与WTO争端解决两条应对路径。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会贸易司公开信息 · 2026.11.06
focus.title_en: EU Final Anti-Subsidy Duties on Chinese EVs: Rethink Supply Chains and Pricing
focus.summary_en: The European Commission has published its final anti-subsidy measures on Chinese electric vehicles, layering differentiated duties on top of the existing 10% base tariff and opening a window for price-undertaking negotiations. Chinese automakers should assess cost pass-through headroom and the feasibility of local assembly, while verifying battery origin and subsidy disclosure. Component and energy-storage suppliers should watch for scope spillover. Build tariff scenario models and keep both price undertakings and WTO dispute settlement in reserve.
focus.source_en: Source: European Commission, DG Trade public information · 2026.11.06

case.title: 境外仲裁裁决在华承认执行：被申请人未举证送达瑕疵，法院裁定予以执行
case.summary: 某内地法院近期审结一起申请承认与执行外国仲裁裁决案。被申请人以未获适当通知、违反正当程序为由抗辩，但未能就仲裁机构送达记录提出反证。法院依据《纽约公约》第五条及互惠原则审查后认定，送达符合仲裁规则即视为适当通知，裁定承认并执行。启示：跨境交易应明确约定送达地址与电子送达方式，争议阶段及时固定送达证据，避免以程序瑕疵作无效抗辩。
case.source: 来源：中国法院涉外民商事审判公开案例综述 · 2026年下半年
case.title_en: Foreign Arbitral Award Enforced in China: Respondent Fails to Prove Defective Notice
case.summary_en: A mainland court recently ruled on an application to recognize and enforce a foreign arbitral award. The respondent argued improper notice and breach of due process but offered no rebuttal of the institution's delivery records. Applying Article V of the New York Convention and reciprocity, the court held that notice in accordance with the arbitration rules constitutes proper notice and enforced the award. Takeaway: stipulate service addresses and e-service methods, preserve delivery evidence, and avoid procedural-defect defenses without proof.
case.source_en: Source: Review of published foreign-related civil and commercial judgments, Chinese courts · H2 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境商事调解与仲裁衔接机制提速，涉外企业争议解决选项增多
policy.summary: 大湾区近期推进跨境商事调解与仲裁的规则衔接与机构协作，前海、南沙、横琴等地探索调解协议跨境执行与临时措施协助。对出海企业而言，可在合同中嵌入“调解前置＋港澳仲裁”分层条款，利用内地与港澳相互执行仲裁裁决的安排降低执行不确定性。建议在起草阶段明确适用规则、仲裁地与语言，并评估调解保密性对后续证据使用的影响。
policy.source: 来源：粤港澳大湾区法律部门联席会议公开信息 · 2026.11
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Speeds Up Mediation-Arbitration Linkage, Widening Dispute Options
policy.summary_en: The Greater Bay Area is advancing rule alignment and institutional cooperation between cross-border commercial mediation and arbitration, with Qianhai, Nansha and Hengqin piloting cross-border enforcement of settlement agreements and interim-measure assistance. For outbound businesses, embedding tiered clauses (mediation first, then Hong Kong/Macau arbitration) can reduce enforcement uncertainty under the mutual enforcement arrangements. Specify rules, seat and language at drafting, and assess mediation confidentiality's effect on later evidence use.
policy.source_en: Source: Public information of the GBA legal departments joint meeting · Nov 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：出口管制“50%规则”外溢下，中国企业须重建股权穿透合规
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美方出口管制中关联方持股穿透规则持续外溢，直接或间接持股达一定比例即可能触发同等许可要求。企业应建立“股权穿透＋物项分类＋最终用途”三张清单，对境外合资、代持与基金架构逐层核查；在采购合同中加入管制变更与许可不能取得时的免责与退出条款，并保留BIS咨询与自愿披露通道。切勿以形式切割替代实质合规。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球·iGlobal Law 编辑部 · 2026.11.06
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Affiliate-Ownership Rules in Export Controls Require Ownership Look-Through Compliance
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: the affiliate-ownership look-through rule in US export controls continues to expand, so direct or indirect stakes above certain thresholds may trigger equivalent licensing requirements. Companies should build three lists—ownership look-through, item classification and end use—and verify offshore JVs, nominee holdings and fund structures layer by layer. Add change-in-control and license-denial exit clauses to procurement contracts, and keep BIS consultation and voluntary self-disclosure channels open. Formal separation is no substitute for substantive compliance.
